rows.question: How heavy is the Aero X2?
rows.answer: The complete Velora Aero X2 bike weighs 21.4 kg including the battery [1].

rows.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get?
rows.answer: Full-time employees receive 25 vacation days per year, in addition to Dutch public holidays [1].

rows.question: Can I send my bike back if I've already ridden it 80 km?
rows.answer: Yes, you can still return your bike within 30 days if you have ridden it more than 50 km (such as 80 km), but a 10% restocking fee applies [1].

rows.question: At what charge level does battery-saver mode switch on now?
rows.answer: Battery-saver mode now activates automatically at 15% charge.

rows.question: Is it safe to clean the bike with a pressure washer?
rows.answer: No, it is not safe to clean the bike with a pressure washer; the motor, battery, and display must not be cleaned with a pressure washer.

rows.question: How long does it take to charge the Aero X2 to 80%, and which firmware version added the option to stop charging at 80%?
rows.answer: Charging the Aero X2 from empty to 80% takes 2.5 hours, and version 3.4 added the option to cap charging at 80%.

rows.question: If I register my bike within 60 days, how long is the battery covered, and what is the battery's rated capacity?
rows.answer: If you register your bike within 60 days, you receive an extended battery warranty of 3 years [1].
rows.missing: The sources do not state the battery's rated capacity (they only mention a rated capacity percentage threshold of 70% and an energy capacity of 540 Wh for the integrated battery in the Aero X2 model).

rows.question: As an employee leasing an Aero X2 through the bike plan, what would it cost to buy the bike at the end of the lease?
rows.answer: At the end of the 36-month lease, you can buy the bike for 15% of its original retail price [1]. With a recommended retail price of EUR 3,290, the purchase price would be EUR 493.50 [1, 3].

rows.question: Range Assist says I have 60 km left on a frosty morning below 0 °C. How far could the real range be off, and is a fix coming?
rows.answer: Range Assist estimates can be up to 20% too optimistic in temperatures below 0 °C [1]. A fix is planned for version 3.5 [1].
